payload.claim: The `pass`-path summary text (`f"{died} of {len(declared)} witness(es) died under their mutant{note}"`) is never asserted by any test — `test_a_witness_that_dies_under_its_mutant_passes` and `test_two_criteria_do_not_see_each_others_mutants` both check `status`/`tool`/`failures` but not `summary`. A typo or wrong count in that f-string (e.g. swapping `died` for `len(declared)`) would not be caught, though this isn't required by any stated acceptance criterion so it's low stakes.
